title: Width scaling: ASPECT_RATIO 64->80 (model_dim 512->640)
description: Changed ASPECT_RATIO from 64 to 80, keeping DEPTH=8 and DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE=128 unchanged, giving model_dim=640 (5 heads) instead of 512 (4 heads); MATRIX_LR=0.06 baseline kept.
reflection: Large win: val_bpb 0.999094 vs baseline 1.012413, a ~1.3% relative improvement -- the biggest single gain in the cell so far, well beyond the noise floor established by the MATRIX_LR runs. VRAM rose from 44GB to 55.4GB, still well under the ~79GB ceiling, confirming this config was safe (as two prior partial round-1 runs at this same shape had already hinted by training cleanly to 86%+ without OOM). This strongly suggests the model was capacity-bound, not token-bound, at the original 512-dim size -- width was the correct lever all along, not depth. Given the headroom left (55GB of 79GB), a natural follow-up is pushing width further (e.g. ASPECT_RATIO=96-128) or combining with a modest depth increase, but that should be tested as its own clean run rather than stacked blindly.
